purpose: Research evidence for read-only analysis and future separately gated native visual work; not a runtime patch manifest

sources.guard_limit: DllMain checks normalized entrypoint only; file size is text in the error message, not a validation condition. No executable SHA256 supplied by source.
sources.reuse: Facts and symbol references only; no GPL implementation copied into MIT native module.

sources.finding: Existing owner of CSM/scenery patches, game callbacks, SMAA/gamma and overlay. Settings persist in CFG with runtime API. Do not stack equivalent hooks or assume installed user version equals current source.

visual_candidates.action: Read-only PE analysis first. Convert VA to RVA only under explicitly verified matching PE image base and target evidence. Do not interpret unbacked virtual BSS as on-disk bytes.
visual_candidates.future_status: experimental; separate native toggle off by default; in-game build and race tests required

visual_candidates.action: Use documented settings of the installed FusionFix build. Reuse existing owner rather than installing duplicate memory hooks.

visual_candidates.action: Prefer read-only import/resource observation; a future standalone ASI must discover actual API resources and hook ownership with rollback, not copy fixed retail IAT ranges.
